# Flash Programmer

**Author:** Microcell Ltd<br/>
**Platforms:** ODM

<div className="screenshot">

![Flash Programmer: screenshot 1](./flash-programmer/img/flash-programmer.png)

</div>

A flasher for the Siemens C62. Uploads the main software, language pack, and personalization package to the phone.

Version 2.83 allows writing GDFS recovery packages. The program requires separate C62 firmware files to operate; they are not included in the catalog.
